title: All core isiZulu slide title source and narration-track check
reviewType: bounded title semantic and binding audit; not fluent approval

binding.head: d9ec7c77b8591ba675f7672ef4af69fb3790a749
binding.provenance: Narration and media sources audited earlier are unchanged from HEAD 58dddd8e064387a4eddb9adb521fedae7e5a1c83.

summary.overall: All 240 module/slide numbers align across source scripts and registered tracks. Concrete title issues include a stale generic Seeds slide 1 script heading, “slows” rendered as possible decrease in water, wattle-specific seed pods generalized, and loss of action/species/frequency/outcome detail in several titles. Three Soil Health audio titles also omit the “Watch” cue present in the source/script heading. This is bounded machine review, not fluent approval.

slides.isiZuluScriptHeadingRaw: Isihloko (Slide 1 — Title)

findings.issue: The ZU script heading is the generic “Isihloko” (“Title”), and its English parenthetical says “Title,” rather than the source heading “Seeds and Seed Sovereignty.” The registered ZU audio title is “Ubukhosi Bembewu.” The audio registry comments identify that phrase as a previously reviewer-signed reuse and explicitly avoid coining a fuller translation.
findings.recommendation: Preserve the currently registered reviewer-signed audio title. Resolve the script-heading placeholder only through the existing title review; do not infer a new ZU phrase from this audit.
